title: New password
description: Choose a password. It will replace the old one as soon as you confirm.

fields.passwordHint: At least eight characters, with one capital and one lowercase letter.

done.title: Password changed
done.description: Your new password is active. Other signed-in devices have been signed out.

rejected.invalid: This reset link is not valid. Your email software may have broken it: open it from the message rather than copying it out.
rejected.expired: This reset link has expired. Ask for a new one — it stays valid for a few hours.
rejected.already_used: This link has already been used. Your password was changed: sign in with the new one.

empty.title: No reset link
empty.description: This page changes a password from the link received by email. Open that link from your mailbox, or ask for a new one.
